The customer has an urgent requirement and has requested delivery by 17 September. Could you please help us fulfil this in time? When is the earliest you can ship this order? Thank you!

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Hi

messages.author: bot
messages.text: Hey Mindyourkicks. That order shipped the same day, so ignore the message above, it crossed with you.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Bhai wo order to kab ka chala gaya tha. Main isliye message kar raha hu ki mere paas ek problem hai. Pichle do hafte se order bahut kam aa rahe hain. Pehle roz 8-10 aate the, ab 2-3. Maine kuch change nahi kiya, price bhi same hai, listing bhi same hai. Aapke system me kuch issue hai ya market hi slow hai, ye samajh nahi aa raha. Zara dekh ke batao.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Dashboard ka video bhej raha hu

messages.author: bot
messages.text: Looked before replying. Your numbers are fine, which is the confusing part. 2.2 days to ship, 94.6 percent fulfilment, 63 rejections in a thousand orders. Nothing on your account is throttling you. What changed is the category. Fragrance listings went from about 400 to about 1,900 on the platform in six weeks, so the same listing now sits behind five times as many competitors.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Achha to competition badh gaya hai

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Phir main kya karun

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Mere top 4 listing

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Ye price hai meri

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Competitor ka price

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Aur ye stock hai

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Dekho, mera price unse 200-300 zyada hai par mera product original hai, unka doubt hai

body.text: quick one before you go, how was the help you got from us today? one tap, and it genuinely helps us improve your seller experience massively

messages.author: customer
messages.text: 5 - Excellent

messages.author: bot
messages.text: noted, appreciate you taking the time

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Bhai price ke baare me kuch soch ke bataya na

messages.author: bot
messages.text: I did, and I'm not going to tell you to cut your price. You're 200 to 300 above the cheapest listings and your product is genuinely original, so cutting just moves you into their margin fight and you lose the one thing you're actually better at. The problem isn't your price, it's that a buyer looking at nineteen hundred listings has no way to see the difference.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Haan yahi problem hai. Buyer ko kaise pata chalega ki mera original hai aur unka nahi

messages.author: bot
messages.text: That's the right question and it isn't mine to answer. There's a verification programme for fragrance being set up and I've asked Seller Ops to look at you for it.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Wo kya hai ji

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Bhai us programme ke baare me kuch pata chala kya aapko, batao zara

messages.author: human
messages.text: Mindyourkicks, Nikhil here from Seller Ops.

messages.author: human
messages.text: I'd like to put you in the fragrance verification pilot. Short version first, detail on Monday.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Ji ji

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Sir aaj Monday ho gaya hai

messages.author: bot
messages.text: Nikhil's putting the detail together. While you wait, the short version from my side: a verified badge on your fragrance listings, and a filter buyers can use to show only verified sellers. You'd be in the first group.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Badge ke liye kya karna padega? Aur isme paisa lagega kya, kyunki mere margin already patle hain fragrance me

messages.author: bot
messages.text: No fee. What it costs you is paperwork. You'd need to show purchase invoices for the lines you list, and agree to spot checks where we pull a unit through the normal flow and verify it ourselves.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Invoice to sab hai mere paas, main distributor se hi leta hu sab kuch

messages.author: bot
messages.text: Then you're most of the way there already. Most sellers who fail this fail because they buy from a grey channel and can't produce an invoice.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Haan wahi log sasta bech rahe hain, unka source hi different hai

messages.author: bot
messages.text: That's exactly the gap the programme is meant to close, and it's why I pushed for you rather than someone with more volume. You ship in two days, your fulfilment is 94, and you buy through a distributor who gives you paper. The whole point of a verified filter is that it only means something if the sellers behind it are actually verifiable. If we put everyone in it, it's decoration.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Sir ka message kab aayega? Main ready hu documents ke saath

messages.author: bot
messages.text: He'll come to you directly. If you haven't heard by Wednesday, tell me and I'll chase it rather than leaving you waiting on a maybe.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Theek hai bhai

messages.author: bot
messages.text: Keep shipping the way you are in the meantime.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Wednesday ho gaya

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Bhai Nikhil sir ka koi message nahi aaya. Main do din se wait kar raha hu. Documents scan karke rakh liye hain, sab invoice ready hai, bas bhejne hain

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Dekho bhai, main pressure nahi banana chahta, par order kam aa rahe hain roz. Is hafte sirf 9 order aaye hain, pichle mahine is hafte me 38 the. Isliye jaldi chahiye tha

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Aur ek baat, agar programme me time lagega to bata do, main tab tak price kam kar dunga. Nuksan ho raha hai, khali baithne se achha hai kam margin pe bech lu. Aap batao kya karna chahiye, main aapki baat maanunga

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Reply kar dena jab time mile bhai, main wait kar raha hu yahan

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Bhai sun lo

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Teen din se koi reply nahi hai. Price kam karun ya nahi, itna bata do bas. Order 9 se 6 pe aa gaye is hafte

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Koi hai yahan pe

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Main price kam kar raha hu, majboori hai bhai

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Kam kar diya

messages.author: human
messages.text: Mindyourkicks, Nikhil here. I owe you an apology before anything else.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Ji

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Sir main price kam kar chuka hu, 300 rupaye kam kiye hain

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Ab aap batao kya karna hai, main confused ho gaya hu

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Programme ka kuch hoga ya nahi hoga

messages.author: human
messages.text: It's happening, and you're in it. The delay was mine.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Sach?

messages.author: human
messages.text: Yes. Your application was approved on the 7th. It's been sitting in my queue unsent for five days because I was waiting on the badge artwork before I wrote to you, which was a stupid reason to leave you in the dark.

messages.author: human
messages.text: On the price cut, undo it if you can. You dropped 300 rupees because we didn't answer you, which is the worst possible reason to give up margin. The badge goes live next week and it does the job the price cut was trying to do, except it doesn't cost you anything per unit.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Ohho

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Kal wapas badha deta hu

messages.author: human
messages.text: Do that. And send me the invoices this week so the first spot check has paper behind it.

messages.author: human
messages.text: There's one more thing you should know.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Haan sir, boliye ji

messages.author: human
messages.text: The verified filter will cut your impressions before it lifts them. Buyers have to discover the filter exists, which takes a few weeks. So expect a flat fortnight.

messages.author: human
messages.text: I'd rather you heard that from me now than decided the badge doesn't work after ten days. The stores in the pilot that gave it a month all came out ahead. The ones that panicked and cut prices didn't.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Ji ji

messages.author: human
messages.text: Invoices came through, thank you. All twelve lines covered, which is more than I expected.

messages.author: human
messages.text: Here's the detail I owed you on Monday, properly this time. The badge appears on your listing card and your store page. The filter sits at the top of the fragrance category. Spot checks are quarterly: we buy one unit at random through the normal flow and verify it, and you don't get told which one. If a check fails you're out of the pilot, and I'd rather tell you that plainly now than have it sit in a document you don't read.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Sir spot check me agar distributor ne hi galat de diya to? Mera to koi control nahi hai us pe

messages.author: human
messages.text: Fair question. If a unit fails and you can produce the purchase invoice for it, we treat it as a supply chain problem and go to your distributor, not to you. Without the invoice, it's on you. Which is why the paper matters.

messages.author: human
messages.text: That's also why I wanted a seller who buys through one distributor rather than five. You have a single traceable source. If something is wrong upstream we can actually find it, and you're not the one who ends up paying for it.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Samajh gaya sir ji

messages.author: human
messages.text: Badge goes live Monday. Nothing else needed from you.

messages.author: human
messages.text: Chanakya will tell you when it's actually showing, because our go-live and the cache clearing are not the same moment.

messages.author: human
messages.text: And if the flat fortnight turns into a flat month, message him and I'll look at whether the filter is being surfaced properly rather than assuming it's your listings.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Thank you sir, bahut badhiya

messages.author: human
messages.text: Good luck with it.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Bhai badge Monday ko live hona tha, aaj Sunday raat hai aur kuch nahi dikha. Listing pe kuch nahi aaya. Invoice bhi bhej diye the maine. Kya hua iska?

messages.author: bot
messages.text: Badge is enabled on your account, I can see the flag set. It isn't rendering on the listing card yet, which is a cache thing at our end, not something wrong with your application.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Kab dikhega ji

messages.author: human
messages.text: Chasing it now, give me a day.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Theek hai sir. Par jaldi karwa do, order 6 pe hi atke hain is hafte bhi, aur price bhi wapas badha diya hai maine

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Main roz check kar raha hu listing pe, kuch nahi dikha raha abhi tak. Kal dekhta hu phir se ek baar

messages.author: human
messages.text: Still chasing. The flag is set on your account but the render is stuck behind a cache we don't control directly. Engineering has it. I'll update you tomorrow.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Sir aaj bhi kuch nahi dikha. Listing pe badge nahi hai. Main check karta rahunga, par batate rahiye kya ho raha hai

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Aur order abhi bhi 6 pe hain. Price wapas badha diya to wo bhi kam ho sakte hain ab. Confuse ho raha hu sir

messages.author: human
messages.text: Still chasing, and I'm aware how that reads on day three. The flag is right, the render is not. Engineering has it flagged now rather than queued.

messages.author: human
messages.text: Let me stop giving you the same update and tell you the actual position, because you've had three days of the same sentence from me. The badge flag on your account is correct. The problem is that the listing card is served from a cache that rebuilds nightly, and the rebuild has been failing since Friday for reasons nothing to do with you. Nobody noticed because nothing visibly broke, it just stopped picking up new flags. So your badge, and the badge of every other seller in the pilot, has been set and invisible for five days. It's being fixed today and the rebuild will be forced rather than waited for. I should have found this on Monday instead of telling you to give me a day, three times over.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Sir ab samajh aaya. Kam se kam sach bata diya aapne. Main kal dekhta hu, aap forced rebuild karwa do phir

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Sir aaj bhi nahi dikh raha hai badge. Rebuild hua kya? Main subah se do baar check kar chuka hu listing pe

messages.author: human
messages.text: Rebuild ran last night and picked up 40 of the 52 pilot sellers. You're in the 12 it missed. Being honest, I don't yet know why. Looking today.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Sir 12 me se main hi hu, ye meri kismat hai. Koi baat nahi, aap dekh lo jab time mile, main wait karta hu

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Par ek baat sochni padegi. Price maine wapas badha diya tha badge ke bharose. Badge nahi aaya to price bhi galat ho gaya, order aur kam ho gaye

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Is hafte 4 order aaye hain sir. Pichle saal is time pe 40 aate the. Bahut tension ho rahi hai

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Main price phir se kam kar du? Aap batao, main aapke bharose ruka hua hu sir

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Jawab de dijiye, kuch bhi ho, bas bata dijiye

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Hi

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Sir aaj koi jawab milega kya mujhe

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Main subah se intezar kar raha hu sir

messages.author: human
messages.text: It's live. Your badge is rendering on all twelve of your fragrance listings, and I've checked three of them myself rather than trusting the flag.

messages.author: human
messages.text: The twelve that got missed had a second flag on the account from an older programme, and the rebuild was picking one flag per seller. You were in that group. It's fixed properly, not patched for you specifically.

messages.author: human
messages.text: On the price, put it back up. Not because I'm confident, but because you've now changed it twice in ten days chasing something that wasn't working, and a listing whose price moves every week reads as unstable to a buyer. Pick the number your margin needs and then hold it for a month without touching it.

messages.author: human
messages.text: And on the four orders this week, that number is real and I'm not going to explain it away. Some of it is the category getting crowded, some of it is you cutting and raising your price, and some of it is five days where the thing meant to help you was invisible.

messages.author: human
messages.text: Two of those three were ours, not yours.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Sir dikh gaya badge! Maine abhi dekha, teen listing pe dikha raha hai. Bahut achha lag raha hai. Filter bhi dikh raha hai category me

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Ab price kitna rakhun sir, aap bata do, main wahi rakh dunga

messages.author: human
messages.text: Put it back where it was before any of this started, the number you were happy with in September. That's 200 to 300 above the cheap listings, which is exactly where a verified seller should sit. The badge is what justifies the gap, so don't give the gap away.

messages.author: human
messages.text: And hold it. If it hasn't moved in three weeks, message Chanakya and we'll look at it together with the filter data, which I'll be able to see by then. What I don't want is you changing it again next Tuesday.

messages.author: human
messages.text: One honest expectation. The filter is new so hardly anyone is using it yet. Your first real lift comes when buyers learn it exists, and that's a month or two rather than a week.

messages.author: human
messages.text: So judge this properly in December, not next Friday.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Theek hai sir, samajh gaya

messages.author: human
messages.text: Good. A spot check will happen at some point, so keep the paper.

messages.author: human
messages.text: One last thing. You've been messaging us for three weeks about an order drop and we handed you a badge that was invisible for five days of it.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Sir?

messages.author: human
messages.text: Thank you.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Nahi sir, aapne sach bataya har baar, wahi kaafi hai. Aur galti maani, ye bahut kam log karte hain. Main to khush hu

messages.author: human
messages.text: Chanakya has your account from here. He'll have the filter data before I do.

messages.author: human
messages.text: And if the December number disappoints, come back to me directly. I'd rather hear it than have you quietly leave.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Zaroor sir, thanks

messages.author: human
messages.text: Right. Good luck with it, and genuinely, thanks for your patience on this one.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Chanakya bhai, aap dekh rahe ho na?

messages.author: human
messages.text: He is, and he has everything. That's me done on this thread, take care.

messages.author: human
messages.text: Actually, one correction to what I said earlier. The spot check for your store is scheduled for January rather than this quarter, because pilot sellers get a grace period. Nobody told you that either.

messages.author: human
messages.text: So you have three months before anyone pulls a unit. Use it to make sure every line you list has an invoice you can find in under a minute, not one you have to go looking for.

messages.author: human
messages.text: Right, now I'm done.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Thank you sir, bahut

messages.author: human
messages.text: Take care. Good luck with it.
